name: md-paste
description: A public Supabase-backed Markdown/HTML paste app.

scripts.build:supabase: vite build --base=/functions/v1/app/ && rm -rf supabase/functions/app/dist && cp -R dist supabase/functions/app/dist
scripts.deploy:supabase: npm run build:supabase && supabase db push && supabase functions deploy paste && supabase functions deploy upload-image && supabase functions deploy app
